/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from links import with_query
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlsplit

params = {'space key': 'hello world', '유니코드': 'café 한글', 'a&b=c': 'x&y=z'}
result = with_query('https://example.test/path', params)
assert result == 'https://example.test/path?space+key=hello+world&%EC%9C%A0%EB%8B%88%EC%BD%94%EB%93%9C=caf%C3%A9+%ED%95%9C%EA%B8%80&a%26b%3Dc=x%26y%3Dz'
assert parse_qsl(urlsplit(result).query) == list(params.items())
for url, expected in [
    ('/p?old=a%20b&raw=x=y#frag?x&y', '/p?old=a%20b&raw=x=y&new=a+b#frag?x&y'),
    ('/p#frag?x', '/p?new=a+b#frag?x'),
    ('/p?', '/p?new=a+b'),
    ('/p?old=1&', '/p?old=1&new=a+b'),
    ('/p#', '/p?new=a+b#'),
]:
    assert with_query(url, {'new': 'a b'}) == expected
for url in ['/p', '/p?', '/p?old=a%20b#frag', '/p#']:
    assert with_query(url, {}) == url
assert with_query('/p', {'n': 42, 'empty': ''}) == '/p?n=42&empty='
print('Passed encoding, order, existing query, fragment, empty mapping, and scalar checks.')
PY

 def with_query(url, params):
